problems.title: Working directly with a quotient
problems.statement: Let $X=[0,2]$, and let $Y$ be obtained by identifying $0\sim2$. Let $q:X\to Y$ be the quotient map. For several subsets of $Y$ specified in class, determine whether they are open by examining their inverse images under $q$.

problems.title: Maps out of a quotient
problems.statement: Let $q:[0,1]\to[0,1]/(0\sim1)$ be the quotient map. Suppose $F:[0,1]\to\mathbb R$ is continuous and $F(0)=F(1)$. Prove that there is a unique continuous function $\overline F:[0,1]/(0\sim1)\to\mathbb R$ such that $F=\overline F\circ q$.

problems.title: A geometric quotient
problems.statement: Define $f:[0,1]\to S^1$ by $f(t)=(\cos(2\pi t),\sin(2\pi t))$. Show that $f$ induces a continuous bijection $\overline f:[0,1]/(0\sim1)\to S^1$.
